# MCP tools: Automations

<!-- Generated by `sidekick.mcp.export_tool_reference` from `contracts/mcp-tools.generated.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

[MCP tool reference](index.md) | 10 model-visible tools. The tools of this area that only the MCP App rooms call are on the [app-only page](app-only.md).

What a run costs: Claude or Claude Code runs a client run on its own side, so the cost it reports is its own estimate. Sidekick stores it as an estimate, shows it as one and never counts it against a money cap. Only the daily limit of runs binds a client run. The money caps (the automation share and the monthly cap) bind only what Sidekick's own server spends on model calls.

## `list_automations`

List the owner's automations (drafts, active and paused ones unless state is given): title, state, runner, model tier, whether the approved spec still matches the current one, and how many suggestions wait.

Access: read

Scopes: requires `automation:read`.

Returns: `AutomationPageOutput` with `items` (array of AutomationSummary), `next_cursor` (string or null).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | string | no | up to 2048 characters; may be null |
| `limit` | integer | no | default `25`; 1 to 50 |
| `state` | string | no | one of `draft`, `active`, `paused`, `archived`; may be null |

## `get_automation`

Read one automation in full: its spec (instruction, sources, allowed effects, thresholds, run budget, model tier), the digest the owner approves, its approval state, whether that approval confirmed applying without a click, and the caps on that.

Access: read

Scopes: requires `automation:read`.

Returns: `AutomationOutput` with `automation` (AutomationRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `automation_id` | uuid | yes | - |

## `save_automation`

Draft a new automation (leave out automation_id; needs title, purpose and instruction) or change one at expected_version.

Access: write

Scopes: requires `automation:read`, `automation:write`.

Returns: `SavedAutomationOutput` with `automation` (AutomationRecord), `ignored_nulls` (array of string).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `changes` | object | yes | Fields to change: omitted or null stays; to empty a field, list it in clear. |
| `changes.allowed_effects` | array of string | no | items: `create_task`, `create_contact`; may be null; What a suggestion may propose. |
| `changes.apply_mode` | string | no | one of `suggest`, `auto_low_risk`; may be null |
| `changes.archived` | boolean | no | may be null; True archives it, false restores it. |
| `changes.auto_effects` | array of string | no | items: `create_task`, `create_contact`; may be null |
| `changes.auto_threshold` | integer | no | 90 to 99; may be null |
| `changes.bulk_threshold` | integer | no | 80 to 99; may be null |
| `changes.cadence` | object | no | may be null; When it is due. |
| `changes.cadence.frequency` | string | yes | - |
| `changes.cadence.local_time` | string | yes | - |
| `changes.cadence.day_of_month` | integer | no | may be null |
| `changes.cadence.interval` | integer | no | default `1` |
| `changes.cadence.last_weekday` | boolean | no | default `false` |
| `changes.cadence.until` | date | no | ISO 8601 date; may be null |
| `changes.cadence.weekdays` | array of integer | no | default `[]` |
| `changes.instruction` | string | no | 1 to 4000 characters; may be null |
| `changes.max_suggestions_per_run` | integer | no | 1 to 25; may be null |
| `changes.model_tier` | string | no | one of `standard`, `strong`; may be null |
| `changes.paused` | boolean | no | may be null |
| `changes.purpose` | string | no | 1 to 300 characters; may be null |
| `changes.run_budget_usd` | number | no | above 0; up to 1000.0; may be null |
| `changes.runner` | string | no | one of `claude`, `claude_code`, `server`, `any`; may be null |
| `changes.sources` | array of string | no | items: `mail`, `calendar`, `chat`, `web`, `sidekick`, `manual`; may be null |
| `changes.title` | string | no | 1 to 120 characters; may be null |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `automation_id` | uuid | no | may be null |
| `clear` | array of "cadence" | no | unique; may be null |
| `expected_version` | integer | no | at least 1; may be null |

A nested field is listed under its parent as `parent.field`; `parent[].field` is a field of each item in the list. Required means required inside its parent.

## `get_automation_report`

What the owner's automations did since the owner last looked (or since a time): counts per automation, totals and a few cards worth a look. ai_summary is AI-written, untrusted.

Access: read

Scopes: requires `automation:read`.

Returns: `AutomationReportOutput` with `automations` (array of ReportRowRecord), `highlights` (array of ReportHighlightRecord), `omitted_automations` (integer), `report_version` (integer), `totals` (ReportCounts), `window` (ReportWindowRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | integer | no | default `5`; 1 to 10 |
| `since` | date-time | no | ISO 8601 date and time; may be null; ISO time with offset; omit for since the owner last looked. |

## `start_automation_run`

Start one run of an approved automation and get its brief: the owner's instruction, what you may propose and the fixed rules.

Access: write

Scopes: requires `automation:run`.

Returns: `StartedRunOutput` with `status` (string), `brief` (string or null), `effect_schemas` (object or null), `limits` (RunLimits or null), `reason` (string or null), `run` (RunRecord or null).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `automation_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `runner` | string | yes | one of `claude`, `claude_code` |
| `occurrence` | string | no | default `"scheduled"`; one of `scheduled`, `manual` |

## `record_automation_results`

Record what you found in a run you started: datapoints (facts you read) and suggestions (proposals; the owner decides, you cannot).

Access: write

Scopes: requires `automation:run`.

Returns: `RecordedResultsOutput` with `already_known` (integer), `datapoints` (array of IndexedIdRecord), `rejected` (array of RejectionRecord), `rejected_datapoints` (array of RejectionRecord), `run` (RunRecord), `suggestions` (array of IndexedIdRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `run_id` | uuid | yes | The run_id start_automation_run returned. |
| `datapoints` | array of object | no | up to 50 items; may be null |
| `datapoints[].fields` | object | yes | Closed fields per kind, as the brief lists them. |
| `datapoints[].kind` | string | yes | one of `person`, `organisation`, `event`, `commitment`, `request`, `note` |
| `datapoints[].source_kind` | string | yes | one of `mail`, `calendar`, `chat`, `web`, `api`, `share`, `sidekick` |
| `datapoints[].source_ref` | string | yes | 1 to 300 characters; Your own reference to the source (a message id). |
| `datapoints[].key` | string | no | 1 to 40 characters; may be null; A name for it, so a suggestion of this call can point at it. |
| `datapoints[].source_label` | string | no | up to 400 characters; may be null |
| `datapoints[].source_received_at` | date-time | no | ISO 8601 date and time; may be null |
| `final` | boolean | no | default `false` |
| `outcome` | string | no | one of `ok`, `nothing_found`, `failed`; may be null; With final=true: how the run went. |
| `suggestions` | array of object | no | up to 25 items; may be null |
| `suggestions[].effect` | string | yes | 1 to 40 characters |
| `suggestions[].payload` | object | yes | - |
| `suggestions[].rationale` | string | yes | up to 2000 characters; Why, in one short sentence. |
| `suggestions[].datapoint_refs` | array of string | no | up to 20 items; The key of a datapoint of this call, or the id of an earlier one. |
| `summary` | string | no | up to 300 characters; may be null; With final=true: one line for the owner's log. |
| `usage` | object | no | may be null |
| `usage.cache_read_tokens` | integer | no | default `0`; 0 to 1000000000000 |
| `usage.cache_write_tokens` | integer | no | default `0`; 0 to 1000000000000 |
| `usage.cost_usd_estimate` | number | no | default `0.0`; 0 to 1000 |
| `usage.input_tokens` | integer | no | default `0`; 0 to 1000000000000 |
| `usage.model` | string | no | up to 120 characters; may be null |
| `usage.output_tokens` | integer | no | default `0`; 0 to 1000000000000 |

A nested field is listed under its parent as `parent.field`; `parent[].field` is a field of each item in the list. Required means required inside its parent.

## `list_suggestions`

List the owner's suggestions from automations, oldest first (pending unless state is given): a line each, flags, the independent check, and the high-confidence groups.

Access: read

Scopes: requires `automation:read`; some arguments or parts of the answer also use `contacts:read`, `tasks:read`.

Returns: `SuggestionPageOutput` with `groups` (array of SuggestionGroupRecord), `hidden` (integer), `items` (array of SuggestionSummary), `next_cursor` (string or null).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `automation_id` | uuid | no | may be null |
| `cursor` | string | no | up to 2048 characters; may be null |
| `group` | string | no | default `"all"`; one of `high_confidence`, `single`, `all` |
| `limit` | integer | no | default `25`; 1 to 25 |
| `state` | string | no | default `"pending"`; one of `received`, `checking`, `pending`, `applied`, `undone`, `dismissed`, `expired` |

## `decide_suggestions`

Approve (applies it) or dismiss up to three suggestions the owner asked you to decide, each at its version.

Access: write

Scopes: requires `automation:write`; some arguments or parts of the answer also use `contacts:write`, `tasks:write`.

Returns: `DecisionsOutput` with `items` (array of DecisionResult).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `items` | array of object | yes | 1 to 3 items |
| `items[].decision` | string | yes | one of `approve`, `dismiss` |
| `items[].expected_version` | integer | yes | at least 1 |
| `items[].suggestion_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `items[].confirmed` | boolean | no | default `false`; App only: the owner confirmed a flagged card. |
| `items[].edits` | object | no | may be null; App only, with an approval: payload fields to change first. |

## `undo_suggestion`

Use this only after asking the user and getting an explicit yes in this turn.

Access: write (destructive)

Scopes: requires `automation:write`; some arguments or parts of the answer also use `contacts:write`, `tasks:write`.

Returns: `UndoOutput` with `state` (string), `suggestion_id` (uuid), `version` (integer), `trashed` (AppliedRecordRef or null).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `expected_version` | integer | yes | at least 1 |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `suggestion_id` | uuid | yes | - |
